info.description: Educational use with uploaded or simulated INR data. Monetary JSON values are decimal strings. JWT identity scopes every business route.
info.title: SubTrack API

get.description: Liveness only; readiness additionally checks PostgreSQL and migration state.

delete.description: Atomically delete the account and its owned records. Its tokens stop working.

post.description:
Submit a confirmed mapping JSON object; poll GET /uploads/{id} for real progress.

Example mapping: {"date":"date","description":"description","amount":"amount","type":"type"}.
Processing is atomic for transactions, detections and charge links.
Safe row warnings are capped at 100.
Bounded preview without persistence. Confirm the suggested mapping on upload.
